title: Workflow [Migrations]
description:
## Migrations
In production, you can't just DROP a table and recreate it - there's real data in there. Migrations are versioned SQL scripts that modify your schema safely.

A migration has two parts:
- **Up**: Apply the change
- **Down**: Undo the change

```sql
-- Migration 001 UP
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN email TEXT;

-- Migration 001 DOWN
ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN email;
```

Tools like Flyway, Alembic, and Drizzle manage migrations automatically, tracking which ones have been applied.


---
## Question:
Why use migrations instead of manually running ALTER TABLE in production?
b1t: Migrations are versioned and can be rolled back
b2t: ALTER TABLE doesn't work in production
b3t: Migrations are faster than ALTER TABLE
